classification: One prospective 24-hour BTC/ETH paper comparison with separately initialized portfolios.

model.variance_rule: sum(exp(median forecast days 2..8)), no subtracting epsilon (conservative floor)

forecast: Use the latest 257 fully closed four-hour candles. Timestral sums the first six forecast medians in variance space. EWMA sums six equal expected steps with a 20-day half-life. Each model is scaled using 28 fully matured, non-overlapping 24-hour historical intervals. The forecast horizon starts at the last closed bar. The paper holding period starts at live entry.
policy: Shared 126-day trend filter, nominal aggregate annualized volatility target 20%, maximum 50% per asset, no leverage. Inactive assets leave cash.
execution: Forecast committed before live public depth requests for both portfolios. Fractional paper fills against displayed bids and asks, 10 bp fee and 2 bp adverse reserve per side.
risk: Use liquidation NAV immediately after entry, 23 hourly checks and exit. On observed drawdown of at least 25% liquidate and halt the affected portfolio. Hourly windows allow ten minutes. Record observed mark coverage.
exit: Request current public depth once the durable entry is 24 hours old. Preserve actual timing. Report exit as late past ten minutes, continue seeking a public quote, and distinguish that from an on-time 24-hour result.
scope: One forward paper observation. No market order or private endpoint. No changes to weekly data or trading rules.
